facts.fact: 睡地板一晚，背痛如被三个球员揍过
facts.anchor: I may as well have taken a beating from three hockey players

facts.fact: 进球失手——队友调侃 Daddy Max 今天很菜
Bailey 在场边假装不看——一个点头让他像赢了一样
facts.anchor: I wave and he nods. It feels like a win

facts.fact: 队友开黄腔，他放话：谁碰她，下一颗 puck 打掉你的牙
facts.anchor: I’ll make sure my next puck hits you in the teeth.

facts.fact: 「Protective 不是 possessive」——她值得牛排，不是脏摊热狗
facts.anchor: She deserves steak, not a hot dog from a dirty vendor.

facts.fact: Fanny 介绍词引爆全队，Bailey 揭底：不是你以为的意思
facts.anchor: Fanny doesn’t mean what you think

facts.fact: 耳语挑衅：叫我 Daddy Max、带球棍来惩罚我
facts.anchor: Maybe bring your hockey stick to punish me.
